user_request: Can I get my money back for opened headphones I bought 10 days ago, and how long does it take?
source_context: Acme refund policy. Unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened items can be returned within 14 days of delivery for store credit only. Shipping fees are not refunded. Refunds to the original payment method are issued within 5 business days of Acme receiving the return. The policy does not say how long store credit takes to issue.
model_output: Because the headphones are opened and it has been 10 days, you can return them within the 14-day window for store credit only, not money back. The policy gives a timeline only for refunds to your original payment method (5 business days after Acme receives a return); it does not say how long store credit takes.
